title: Python Full Stack: Fresher to Experienced Level
description: The Python counterpart of the Java Full Stack tree, in the same order: the Python language and CPython, DSA, FastAPI, Django and Flask, databases and Redis, operating systems and networks, microservices and Kafka, system design, delivery, React and interviews. Every code example is run when the site is built. Language-neutral guides (operating systems, networks, databases, Redis, Kafka, high-level design) are the same deep guides as in the Java tree.
